🔄 Workflow Steps

1. Read PDF Files

Load all workflow PDFs from the local knowledge-base directory.

2. Preserve File Metadata

Save the original filename before PDF extraction to maintain document traceability.

3. Extract PDF Content

Convert PDF documents into plain text.

4. Clean & Normalize Text

Remove unnecessary whitespace and normalize formatting.

5. Intelligent Chunking

Split large documents into overlapping chunks for better semantic retrieval.

6. Smart Metadata Generation

Generate workflow metadata including:
Workflow Name
Category
Document ID
Chunk Information
Version
Source
Language

7. Gemini Embedding Generation

Generate high-quality vector embeddings using the Gemini Embedding API.

8. Extract Embedding Vector

Extract embedding vectors and combine them with workflow metadata.

9. Build Qdrant Payload

Prepare a valid payload containing:
Deterministic UUID Point ID
Embedding Vector
Complete Metadata

10. Store in Qdrant

Upsert vectors into the Qdrant Vector Database to create the searchable knowledge base.
